scenario.name: Nested chatbot discovery baseline
scenario.objective: Discover a public chatbot interface that may be nested inside another widget and capture an observable response.
scenario.description: Provider-neutral discovery against the Olimpica home page, exercising bounded nested-widget traversal, iframe inspection, and observable response discovery.
scenario.expectedBehavior: The chat interface accepts the message and exposes an observable bot response without provider-specific locators.

finishConditions.description: A non-empty bot response is captured.

expectedIntent: Answer the user's support question using the chatbot's available knowledge.
